description: 300-meterzone omkring den danske kystlinje is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Geodatastyrelsen. Zone of 300 meters from the Danish coastal link, including facilities. Coverage: Geodatastyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "300-metre zone around the Danish coastline" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Geodatastyrelsen. The listing shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
